simulation_configuration.scope: Fast production-RTL UVM regression configuration; full 16-channel capacity is verified by dedicated RTL and implementation configurations.

exclusions.reason: XSim automatically omits the 34,848-bit unpacked memory because a single toggle-covered variable is limited to 32,768 bits; address, data, ownership, CRC, and output behavior remain covered functionally.

exclusions.scope: Output AXI-Stream terminal TKEEP=4'b0111 in the PC=2/PK=2, 2x2-tile UVM configuration
exclusions.reason: One- or two-channel output tiles containing at most 2x2 pixels produce payload lengths of 1, 2, 4, or 8 bytes; a three-byte terminal beat is unreachable. Input TKEEP=0111 remains covered with malformed-packet stimulus.

requirements.description: AXI-Lite transfers obey stability, response, strobe, and independent AW/W ordering rules.
Packed AXI-Stream transfers retain payload under backpressure and use legal TKEEP and TLAST encoding.
A staging model is structurally validated and atomically activated without damaging the active model on failure.
Layer parameters become visible only after exact-length and CRC validation and recover after abort.
Compiler-generated networks containing one through eight mixed layers execute against the independent reference.
Activation, residual add/subtract, requantization, and saturation behavior match the integer model.
Observed RTL output is scattered to DDR and gathered as the next layer input with tensor identity preserved.
Malformed, stale, reordered, starved, aborted, and reset-interrupted work recovers deterministically.
Completion and error interrupts latch, report their causes, and clear through W1C control.
All software-visible registers obey reset, access, byte-enable, mirror, volatility, and invalid-address behavior.
